title: Obedience Is Where Truth Becomes Allegiance
headline: Knowing the Bible vs. Obeying It
headline_sub: Obedience Is Where Truth Becomes Practiced Allegiance
tagline: Biblical knowledge can inform you without yet forming you.
seo_title: Knowing the Bible vs. Obeying It: James 1:22 for Men | TheWrkShop
seo_description: You can underline, teach and quote a truth and still resist obeying it. A devotional for men on James 1:22 and John 14:21 about obedience and formation.
verse_text: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.

scriptures.text: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.
Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me….
….you are slaves of the one you obey….

items: You can know something without being formed by it.
You can underline it.
Highlight it.
Teach it.
Quote it.
Win an argument about it.
Lead a Bible study on it.
And still resist obeying it.

blocks.text: James gives us a startling warning:
Hearing truth is not the same as submitting to truth.

items: Scripture isn’t merely information to collect.
It calls for allegiance.
And allegiance becomes visible through obedience.

sections.label: Knowing Is Not the Same as Becoming

items: Imagine someone who knows everything Scripture says about forgiveness.
He can quote Matthew 18 and Ephesians 4.
He can explain the cross.
But there is one person he refuses to forgive.
Truth reached his mind.
But in this territory, truth has not yet been permitted to govern his response.
Knowledge matters enormously.
We cannot obey truth we do not know.
But knowledge becomes formational as truth moves toward agreement, surrender, obedience and practice.
Revelation: God has spoken.
Understanding: I begin to understand what He has said.
Agreement: I recognize His truth as authoritative.
Surrender: My competing desire comes under His lordship.
Obedience: I act on what God has revealed.
Repetition: Faithful responses become practiced.
Character: Christlike responses become recognizable.
Direction: My life increasingly moves under the lordship of Jesus.

blocks.text: Obedience is where truth becomes practiced allegiance.

items: Disobedience often requires a story that makes disobedience seem reasonable.
Desire can be loud without being Lord.
Failure can become information without becoming identity.
Sometimes the next step in spiritual formation isn’t learning something new. It is obeying what God has already made clear.
Every ordinary act of obedience answers an extraordinary question: Who is Lord here?
